additional_info.subject: Case note
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The second socket of the charging station appears as
“Busy”
on both the dashboard and the mobile application. However, the socket is physically available on site and charging sessions can be started successfully.
A reset was performed on the station, but the status did not change.
Kindly investigate the issue and advise on corrective actions or next steps.
Best regards,
Şahin

additional_info.body:
Dear Şahin,
Following your report and after our check, we can confirm that your charger does not have an AC charging point active. It only has two outlets  Outlet 1 and Outlet 2. The AC charging point does not exist in the charger’s outlet configuration.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0456896-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/T5 314287183001] PO Pendik - Socket 2 Stuck in ‘Busy’ Status CRM:03056000258
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Yes, the charger has two DC outlets, and the configuration has been set accordingly.
However, Outlet 2 remains in a “Busy” status even though no active charging session is in progress.
Best regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0456896-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/T5 314287183001] PO Pendik - Socket 2 Stuck in ‘Busy’ Status CRM:03056000258
additional_info.body:
Dear Şahin,
Thank you for your clarification. I just wanted to confirm this point with you before proceeding with a deeper check and analysis of the issue.
As mentioned, your charger has two DC outlets (Outlet 1 and Outlet 2), and no AC socket is available in its configuration. I wanted to make sure this is clear, since the initial report mentioned “Socket 2 stuck in ‘Busy’,” which suggested an AC socket issue.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
